Priya (CS): Heads up  EmberCare (renewal in 6w) has a sudden usage collapse since Mar 18. Tokens -68%, seats down. Procurement sent an RFP note. Flagging renewal risk.

Ava (CSM): Marcus (champion) says infra paused production calls after seeing repeated 5xx. Hes worried about SLAs.

Miguel (SE): Quick log sample shows proxy rejects and increased timeouts around 2026-03-18T14:02Z. No changes on our fleet. Hypothesis: customer proxy or edge config tightened limits.

Noah (AM): I'll reach out to Ben (procurement) and propose a short trial or isolated pool. Want legal-friendly terms.

Priya (CS): Proposed steps: 1) Tech sync w/ Ember infra + Miguel to repro (tomorrow 10am PT). 2) Offer 30-day isolated Dedicated pool to prove stability. 3) QBR invite to new ML lead + procurement to reframe ROI.

Miguel (SE): Confirmed for 10am PT. I'll prepare a 3-step repro and a curl snippet to surface proxy limits.

Ava (CSM): I'll send a 1-pager enablement checklist to Marcus and try to re-engage the champion before the sync.

Priya (CS): Owners: Miguel - repro/runbook; Noah - procurement outreach & trial terms; Ava - champion touch + enablement doc; Priya - update risk score and draft renewal note. Post sync notes here. :thumbsup:
